title: Corpium
description: Corpium is one of the oldest German Minecraft servers and has been around since 2011. We offer a fair, non-pay-to-win gaming experience, a mature community, and continuously updated content for long-term fun.
body:
![First Paragraph](https://assets.corpium.net/modrinth/modrinth_description_part_1.png)

- In the wilderness on natural plots
- In Symphonia, our custom residential area consisting of 8 individual biomes
- In the city on flat plots of land
- In Sonnenberg, our suburban residential area
- Middle class, simple, or elite
- On our palm island with a vacation vibe
- With the possibility of multiple plots of land

![Second Paragraph](https://assets.corpium.net/modrinth/modrinth_description_part_2.png)

- A friendly community
- Close contact with the staff team
- Many active regular players
- A well-attended TeamSpeak
- A friendly tone
- Helpfulness among members
- An active forum & active Discord server

![Third Paragraph](https://assets.corpium.net/modrinth/modrinth_description_part_3.png)

- Hundreds of custom items that complement the vanilla game in many ways
- Unique storage system for storing and organizing large quantities of items
- Many custom monsters and creatures with their own drops
- Jobs tailored to the server concept
- A proven economic system with our own currency
- Shops that can be purchased with a specially developed shop system for players in our city center
- Our own attribute & enchantment system with new enchantments
- Runes with unique functions that can be applied to items
- Many custom textures and GUIs using our resource pack

![Fourth Paragraph](https://assets.corpium.net/modrinth/modrinth_description_part_4.png)

- Periodic events such as MontagsMaler, auctions, and Blocki raffles
- Variable events - a mix of familiar favorites such as Sky PvP, Memory, and more
- A variety of specially developed events and rallyes
- Joint activities and excursions
- Events that can be played at any time, such as Tetris, Connect Four, and more
- Our amusement park 'Mine-Park' and the play and fun farm
- Regular building events and competitions

![Fifth Paragraph](https://assets.corpium.net/modrinth/modrinth_description_part_5.png)

- A creative world for projects, skins in Skinorama, and pixel art in our PixelArt gallery
- Over 70 hidden Easter eggs, with a dynamic overview on our website
- Adventure maps & jump 'n' runs
- Many buildings to discover
- Elaborate seasonal events for Easter, Halloween, and Christmas
- Ranking system based on online time
- ArtDeko - Decorate with armor stands
- And much more...

![Sixth Paragraph](https://assets.corpium.net/modrinth/modrinth_description_part_6.png)
